card.name: The word other after "any" or "or"
card.fires_on: The word "other" (or "another") right after "any" or "or" at the end of a list of examples, as in "or any other sign of hypersensitivity".

modes.label: any other
modes.description: "other" follows "any" after a list of signs, symptoms or components.
modes.example: Discontinue ciprofloxacin immediately at the first appearance of a skin rash, jaundice, or any<< other>> sign of hypersensitivity and supportive measures instituted

modes.label: or other / another
modes.description: "other" or "another" follows "or" and closes a list of options or drugs.
modes.example: Select an injection site on the abdomen, upper buttocks, or<< another>> location with adequate amounts of subcutaneous
